title: Web app manifest and launcher icon set
when: The user needs the manifest fields and the full icon set so the installed app looks sharp on launchers, splash screens and app switchers.
prompt:
Goal: manifest.webmanifest plus a complete icon set that stays crisp and uncropped on every launcher shape and splash screen.
Steps:
1. Start from one square 1024 px master with the logo centered on an opaque background.
2. Export icons/icon-192.png and icons/icon-512.png with purpose "any", and icons/maskable-512.png with the logo inside the central 80 percent circle and purpose "maskable".
3. Export icons/touch-180.png and link it with rel="apple-touch-icon"; one launcher ignores manifest icons.
4. Manifest: id "./", name, short_name (12 characters max), start_url "./?source=homescreen", scope "./", display "standalone", background_color = splash color, theme_color = header color.
5. Each icon entry has src, sizes ("512x512"), type ("image/png") and purpose.
6. Add up to 3 shortcuts ({ name, url, icons }) for top actions.
Quality bar:
- No transparent pixels in the maskable icon.
- Splash color matches the first screen so launch has no color flash.
Pitfalls:
- One file marked purpose "any maskable", which looks shrunken or cut on some launchers.
- Setting orientation "portrait" for a layout that also works in landscape.
- Changing id after release, which makes installs look like a new app.
Verify:
- [ ] manifest.webmanifest parses and has name, start_url, display and icons.
- [ ] Every icon file listed exists with the stated size.
- [ ] The maskable icon survives a circle crop preview.
Output: manifest.webmanifest, the icons/ folder and the head links in index.html.

examples.input: make the icons and manifest for my installable app, logo attached
examples.output: manifest.webmanifest with any and maskable 192/512 icons, touch icon link and two shortcuts
